lanes.name: CRM / Order Capture

nodes.label: Queue Ticket Transaction
nodes.desc: One activation, migration, home move or portability process may be initiated per queue ticket transaction (BR-001).

nodes.label: Journey & Session Management
nodes.desc: Follows the same JSM capability as Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001). Tracking record created and owned by initiating agent (BR-002). (BR-001).

nodes.label: Tracking Record Created
nodes.desc: Tracking record created automatically at journey initiation (Status_Model: Tracking Record New -> In Progress).

nodes.label: Customer Identification & Verification
nodes.desc: Follows the same KYC capability as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001). (BR-003).

nodes.label: Customer & Account Management
nodes.desc: Follows the same CAM capability as Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001). (BR-014).

nodes.label: Address Locked After Check
nodes.desc: Installation address updated after RFS check and rendered non-editable; recapture required to change (BR-026).

nodes.label: Proof of Address Upload
nodes.desc: Tenancy document uploaded as PDF or Word, max 2MB (BR-022, P-01, P-03).

nodes.label: Eligibility & Credit Control
nodes.desc: Follows same ECC capability as Mobile Post Paid Journey. Permits only Qatar ID holders taking postpaid (BR-030). Credit source: EDW for existing customer, Qatar Credit Authority for new (BR-031). Blocks blacklisted/collections (BR-032) and outstanding-threshold breach (BR-033, Open — threshold value TBC by VFQ). Follows the same ECC capability as the Mobile Postpaid journey (MPAR_001_ECC_*, FAR_001_ECC_01).

nodes.label: Eligibility Failure Message
nodes.desc: Distinct validation message displayed per eligibility failure so the agent can communicate the reason to the customer (BR-030).

nodes.label: Billing Account Management
nodes.desc: Follows same BAM capability as Mobile Post Paid Journey (billing account creation/selection, billing contact model, payment profile, bill cycle). (BR-040).

nodes.label: Workforce Failure Handling
nodes.desc: Fault ticket created if technician reports an issue during activation; WFM task updated on ticket closure; appointment can be rescheduled (BR-077).

nodes.label: Cart Validation & Check Out
nodes.desc: Follows same CVC capability as Mobile Post Paid Journey (pre-payment validation gate, eligibility/compatibility/cardinality rule check, payment request summary display). (BR-040).

nodes.label: Payment & Inventory
nodes.desc: Follows same PAY capability as Mobile Post Paid Journey (payment summary, upfront charge/deposit, WinCash handling, receipt issuance). (BR-040).

nodes.label: Order Submission
nodes.desc: Order submitted once all sections complete and payment status is paid (BR-093).

nodes.label: Order Submission & Fulfilment Routing
nodes.desc: Follows same ORD capability as Mobile Post Paid Journey. (BR-040).

nodes.label: Order Notification
nodes.desc: Same NOT capability as Mobile Post Paid Journey; for WFM activities, feedback/survey done separately at WFM system. (BR-040).

nodes.label: Order Status to Workforce / CRM
nodes.desc: Order status updated to WFM so technician may proceed; CRM receives activation status (BR-100).

nodes.label: Instant Activation Eligibility Detection
nodes.desc: Detects from RFS response whether a reusable pre-installed device exists and is eligible for instant activation (BR-130, Open).

nodes.label: Device Serial Verification
nodes.desc: Agent verifies detected device serial number against the physical device before instant activation proceeds; mismatch recorded (BR-131, Open).

nodes.label: Instant or Normal Selection
nodes.desc: Agent selects explicitly between instant and normal activation, defaulting to normal where not selected (BR-132, Open).

nodes.label: Appointment Auto-Skip
nodes.desc: Appointment booking auto-skipped for instant activation; agent retains flexibility to book on customer request (BR-133).

nodes.label: Immediate Activation Trigger
nodes.desc: Immediate network activation flow triggered on order submission; agent notified of activation outcome (BR-134, Open).

nodes.label: Instant Activation Failure Handling
nodes.desc: Support request raised and technician visit arranged where service does not work following instant activation (BR-135, Open).

nodes.label: Channel Constraint
nodes.desc: Instant activation available only to field agents on a tablet device; physical device verification not supported on desktop-only agent (BR-136).

nodes.label: Migration Request
nodes.desc: Migration request raised by the customer, captured and confirmed; customer notified (BR-140, Open — request details format TBC by VFQ).

nodes.label: Migration Eligibility Validation
nodes.desc: Migration permitted only for active FWA Indoor/Outdoor services with no open fulfilment, termination, portability or home-move orders (BR-140A). Ineligible services blocked with reason displayed.

nodes.label: Migration Blocked
nodes.desc: Ineligible services are blocked and the reason is displayed (FIB_MIG_RTL_003_01). (BR-140A).

nodes.label: Customer Verification
nodes.desc: Customer identity verification required before migration initiation; migration cannot proceed without success (BR-141).

nodes.label: Fibre Service Availability Validation
nodes.desc: Fibre availability at target installation address validated before migration order creation; proceeds only where Fibre RFS status is available (BR-140B).

nodes.label: Existing Service Retrieval
nodes.desc: Retrieves existing service, equipment, MSISDN, SIM and billing information from the active FWA subscription; displayed to agent before confirmation (BR-142).

nodes.label: Migration Order Capture
nodes.desc: Captures migration order, customer contact preference, language, alternate number (BR-142).

nodes.label: Installation Appointment Creation
nodes.desc: Creates a Fibre installation appointment through WFM; appointment mandatory for all migrations (BR-143).

nodes.label: Telesales CAF/Tenancy Flag
nodes.desc: Automatically flags CAF and tenancy document collection for telephone-originated migration requests; collection flags passed to WFM (BR-143).

nodes.label: Outdoor Device Recovery Appointment
nodes.desc: Creates a device recovery appointment when migrating from FWA Outdoor to Fibre; recovery task exists before migration completion (BR-144).

nodes.label: Existing Service Continuity
nodes.desc: Existing FWA service kept active until Fibre installation successfully completed; no interruption before successful activation (BR-145A).

nodes.label: Fibre Activation Trigger
nodes.desc: Fibre activation triggered only after successful installation closure from WFM (BR-145B).

nodes.label: SIM Deactivation
nodes.desc: FWA SIM deactivated only after successful Fibre activation; SIM remains active until Fibre activation succeeds (BR-145).

nodes.label: Resource Release
nodes.desc: Releases FWA-specific resources, SIM inventory and associated network resources following successful migration (BR-145C).

nodes.label: Billing Migration
nodes.desc: Terminates FWA recurring charges and activates Fibre recurring charges on migration completion date; billing reflects the migrated service only (BR-145D).

nodes.label: Customer Notification
nodes.desc: Notifies customer at migration request creation, appointment booking, activation success and failure events (BR-145E).

nodes.label: Migration Completed
nodes.desc: Migration journey complete: Fibre active, FWA service terminated, billing migrated, customer notified.

nodes.label: Migration Failure Handling
nodes.desc: Retains the FWA service and raises a support ticket when Fibre installation or activation fails; failed migration shall not automatically terminate the existing FWA service (BR-145F).

nodes.label: Home Move Request
nodes.desc: Created through the retail store queue, or via a support agent (customer calls) assigning to the fibre fulfilment team queue (BR-150).

nodes.label: New Installation Address Capture
nodes.desc: Captures new installation address for the home move and checks service availability for the new location (BR-151).

nodes.label: New Location Installation Appointment
nodes.desc: Follows same WFM capability as Fiber Activation Journey (FAR_001_WFM_01 to WFM_06). (BR-070, BR-072).

nodes.label: Fixed Line Number Retention
nodes.desc: New fixed line number selection is not permitted for a home move order; a new fixed line number must be refused (BR-152).

nodes.label: Old Location Device Handling
nodes.desc: Fibre-to-fibre move: no uninstallation appointment, device retained at old location (BR-153). FWA outdoor origin: uninstallation appointment captured for the outdoor device at old location (BR-154).

nodes.label: Outdoor Device Uninstallation Appointment
nodes.desc: Uninstallation appointment for the FWA outdoor device at the old location captured for a move originating from FWA outdoor (BR-154).

nodes.label: Old Location Service Termination
nodes.desc: Terminates all services at the old location on the confirmed move date (BR-155).

nodes.label: Old Location Inventory Release
nodes.desc: Releases CPE and IP address at old location on confirmed move date (BR-156).

nodes.label: WFM Task Execution at New Location
nodes.desc: Follows same WFM capability as Fiber Activation Journey (FAR_001_WFM_07 to WFM_10). (BR-073, BR-076).

nodes.label: Move Date Billing Update
nodes.desc: Billing updated on move date with new plan/resources at new location and for terminated services at old location (BR-157).

nodes.label: FWA Equipment Carried by Customer
nodes.desc: Records that FWA CPE is carried by the customer to the new location where the move is to a FWA service area (BR-158).

nodes.label: Home Move Completed
nodes.desc: Home move journey complete: new location active, old location terminated and billed.

nodes.label: Port In Request
nodes.desc: Fixed line number being ported in is captured; new number selection not permitted for a port-in journey (BR-160).

nodes.label: Ported Number Capture
nodes.desc: Captures the fixed line number being ported in (BR-160).

nodes.label: Portability Form Submission
nodes.desc: Agent completes and submits the portability form; customer signs; signed form uploaded before port-in proceeds (BR-162).

nodes.label: Portability Request Creation
nodes.desc: Creates the portability request based on the portability identifier; submits to the Number Portability Administration System (BR-163).

nodes.label: Portability Request Confirmation
nodes.desc: Receives update on the portability request from NPAS after approval/rejection by donor service provider (BR-164).

nodes.label: Port In Rejected
nodes.desc: Portability request rejected by donor service provider.

nodes.label: Portability WFM Appointment Execution
nodes.desc: Triggers WFM task for FLN change based on confirmed port-in date received on or before the captured portability appointment date; date rescheduled based on confirmed port-in date (BR-164A, Open).

nodes.label: Portability Activation After Completion
nodes.desc: Activates the ported fixed line number after portability completion; configured during the WFM task; no temporary number provided (BR-165).

nodes.label: Port In Completed
nodes.desc: Port-in journey complete: number activated on VFQ network.

nodes.label: Port Out Request Received
nodes.desc: Trouble ticket automatically created in CRM on receipt of a port-out request from NPAS, carrying ticket and order identifiers (BR-170).

nodes.label: Port Out Trouble Ticket Created
nodes.desc: Trouble ticket created (BR-170).

nodes.label: Queue Assignment & Initial SLA Timer
nodes.desc: Auto-assigned to the portability queue; initial validation service level timer started (BR-171, Open, P-11: 2 hours).

nodes.label: Outstanding Bill Handling
nodes.desc: Pending bill moves request to Conditionally Accepted with a defined settlement window (BR-174, P-13: 24 hours).

nodes.label: Service Level Extension
nodes.desc: Service level timer extended from initial period to final action period where documents are valid (BR-175, P-12: 24 hours).

nodes.label: Automatic Processing on Breach
nodes.desc: Request auto-processed per the configured rule where no action taken within the service level (BR-176, Open — auto-accept vs auto-reject logic TBC).

nodes.label: Status Communication to NPAS
nodes.desc: Every accept, reject and conditional acceptance action communicated to NPAS using defined status codes (BR-177, Open — full rejection code list TBC by VFQ).

nodes.label: Termination Order Generation
nodes.desc: Termination order generated from the closed ticket, linked to it, wish date set to the confirmed portability date and non-editable (BR-178).

nodes.label: Network Deactivation
nodes.desc: Services deactivated on confirmed portability date with a one-hour activation window towards the new provider (BR-179, P-15: 1 hour).

nodes.label: Inventory Quarantine
nodes.desc: Ported inventory marked to quarantine for the configured period (P-16: 90 days); SIM deactivated and released for FWA service (BR-180).

nodes.label: Port Out Completed
nodes.desc: Port-out journey complete: service deactivated, inventory quarantined.

nodes.label: Termination Request Initiation
nodes.desc: Retail Agent or Retention Agent initiates a termination request from Customer 360 for an active Fibre or FWA service (BR-200).

nodes.label: Customer & Service Eligibility Validation
nodes.desc: Validates customer identity, service status, open orders, active disputes, fraud/legal blocks and pending termination requests; distinct reason displayed per failure (BR-201).

nodes.label: Retention Handling
nodes.desc: Routes to retention process where required; retention outcome captured (retained, proceed to terminate, customer unreachable) before termination order creation (BR-202).

nodes.label: Customer Retained
nodes.desc: Customer accepts retention outcome and does not proceed with termination.

nodes.label: Outstanding Dues Validation
nodes.desc: Retrieves outstanding balance; prevents or conditionally allows termination based on configured VFQ settlement rule (BR-203).

nodes.label: Penalty Charge Display
nodes.desc: Calculates and displays applicable early termination/lock-in penalty before confirmation (BR-204; plan lock-in is 3 months per CAF).

nodes.label: Equipment Recovery Appointment
nodes.desc: WFM appointment triggered/allowed for equipment recovery where service type and device ownership rule require it, including FWA outdoor device recovery; skipped where not applicable (BR-206, Open).

nodes.label: Termination Order Capture
nodes.desc: Captures termination reason and requested termination date before submitting the order, along with appointment and payment details; consent, reason and date mandatory (BR-205, Open).

nodes.label: Termination Order Submission
nodes.desc: Creates and submits termination order to Order Management after all mandatory validations, consent and recovery requirements are satisfied (BR-207, Open).

nodes.label: Network Deactivation
nodes.desc: Deactivates the fixed/FWA service on the confirmed termination date; returns deactivation outcome to CRM (BR-208, Open).

nodes.label: Billing Closure
nodes.desc: Updates billing after termination including final charges, penalty, refund/credit where applicable and service closure status (BR-209, Open).

nodes.label: Inventory Release
nodes.desc: Releases fixed line number, CPE, ONT, FWA SIM/equipment and IP resources based on service type and configured release/quarantine rules (BR-210, Open).

nodes.label: Customer Notification
nodes.desc: Notifies customer on termination request creation, order submission, appointment where applicable and completion/failure (BR-211, Open).

nodes.label: Termination Inventory Quarantine
nodes.desc: Ported inventory marked to quarantine for the configured period; SIM deactivated and released for FWA service (BR-180).

nodes.label: Termination Completed
nodes.desc: Termination journey complete: service deactivated, billing closed, inventory released/quarantined.

nodes.label: GIS Data Ingestion
nodes.desc: Site and building data from the geographic information system ingested into the inventory management system, the master for building and connectivity data (BR-190).

nodes.label: Go-to-Market File Generation
nodes.desc: Go-to-market file generated from the inventory management system as a full extract (BR-191).

nodes.label: Pickup & Transformation
nodes.desc: Go-to-market file picked up through the mediation layer, filtered and transformed into the format required by each downstream system (BR-192, Open).

nodes.label: Distribution to Downstream Systems
nodes.desc: Distributed to inventory management system (full extract), RFS portal, CRM (delta) and analytics data warehouse (BR-193, Open).

nodes.label: Operator Identifier Generation & Mapping
nodes.desc: Operator identifier generated separately and mapped to the utility identifier through field survey, supporting one-to-one and one-to-many relationships (BR-194, Open).

nodes.label: Ready for Service Status Update
nodes.desc: Marks a building ready for service once ready for provisioning; records applicable service level category (BR-195, Open).

nodes.label: RFS Portal Search
nodes.desc: Sales team searches the RFS portal by address, utility identifier or area (BR-196).

nodes.label: Recommendation Integration
nodes.desc: Receives offer recommendations from the big data system into the RFS portal (BR-197, Open).

nodes.label: Lead Creation from Portal
nodes.desc: Sales agent creates a lead in CRM from the RFS portal using the customer mobile number (BR-198, Open).

nodes.label: Continuous RFS Update
nodes.desc: RFS data updated through subsequent go-to-market file loads and through manual updates from the business (BR-199).

nodes.label: RFS Data Ready
nodes.desc: RFS data management cycle complete; portal reflects current serviceability for downstream sales and activation journeys.

nodes.label: Present Eligible Base Plans
nodes.desc: System presents only the fibre base plans eligible for the customer, determined by the service type available at the address. (BR-050).

nodes.label: Bundle IPTV by Default
nodes.desc: System bundles the IPTV offering by default with the base plan and displays all associated child plans. (BR-051).

nodes.label: Remove IPTV Offering
nodes.desc: Retail Agent may remove the IPTV offering from the cart at customer request. (BR-051).

nodes.label: Add Mapped Add-Ons Only
nodes.desc: Retail Agent may add only an add-on pre-configured and mapped to the base plan; unmapped add-ons are blocked. (BR-052).

nodes.label: Display Mapped Discounts Only
nodes.desc: System displays only a discount mapped to the product; the section is empty where none applies. (BR-053).

nodes.label: Recalculate Cart Price
nodes.desc: System recalculates one-time charges, recurring charges and discounts whenever a product is added, amended or removed from the cart. (BR-054).

nodes.label: Select Fixed Line Number
nodes.desc: Retail Agent searches the free number list and selects a preferred fixed line number into the cart. (BR-060).

nodes.label: Select Mobile Number for FWA
nodes.desc: Retail Agent searches the free number list and selects a mobile number into the cart, only for a fixed wireless access journey. (BR-061).

nodes.label: Prohibit Star Number for FWA
nodes.desc: A star number may not be selected for a fixed wireless access indoor or outdoor journey. (BR-061).

nodes.label: FLN Selection
nodes.desc: Retail Agent searches the FLN from the list of FLN and adds it to the cart; a FLN can be searched and added for a Fiber or Fixed Wireless Access journey (BR-060).

nodes.label: MSISDN Selection (FWA)
nodes.desc: Follows the same NUM capability as Mobile Post Paid Journey (MPAR_001_NUM_13). A search returns available free numbers restricted to fixed wireless access journeys and a selected mobile number is added to the cart; a star number is not offered or selectable for a fixed wireless access journey (BR-061).

nodes.label: Review Number Before Confirmation
nodes.desc: System displays the number category and applicable charges for the agent to review before the number selection is confirmed. (BR-063).

nodes.label: Upload Offline Signed CAF
nodes.desc: Retail Agent uploads a manually signed contract application form (PDF/JPG). Follows the same CAF capability as the Mobile Postpaid journey (MPAR_001_CAF_*, FAR_001_CAF_01). (BR-040, BR-082).

nodes.label: Capture Digital Signature
nodes.desc: Retail Agent selects the digital CAF option and touch-screen option; system displays the captured signature. (BR-083).

nodes.label: Skip CAF by Fulfilment Role
nodes.desc: The CAF submission step may be skipped by an agent holding the fulfilment role. (BR-084).

nodes.label: Upload Supporting Documents
nodes.desc: Retail Agent uploads additional and supporting documents into a separate section (PDF/JPG). (BR-082).

nodes.label: Capture Activity Comments
nodes.desc: Retail Agent captures activity comments to be passed to the field workforce management task. (BR-085).

nodes.label: Search Point of Presence
nodes.desc: Retail Agent searches the point of presence in the ready-for-service screen by address or utility identifier. (BR-023).

nodes.label: Auto-fill Address from RFS
nodes.desc: System auto-fills the address from the ready-for-service data based on the utility identifier. (BR-023).

nodes.label: Display Available Service Types
nodes.desc: System displays the service types available at the searched location: Fibre, FWA indoor, FWA outdoor. (BR-024).

nodes.label: Detect CPE / ONT Information
nodes.desc: System displays the CPE and ONT information retrieved from the ready-for-service response, where available. (BR-025).

nodes.label: Capture WFM Task Execution
nodes.desc: System captures from the field workforce management task the ONT serial number, set-top box and related fulfilment data. (BR-073).

nodes.label: Apply Complimentary Mesh Device Rule
nodes.desc: System applies the configured complimentary allowance of two mesh devices before charging further mesh devices. (BR-074).

nodes.label: Capture Indoor & Outdoor Device Serials
nodes.desc: System captures both the indoor and outdoor CPE serial numbers for a fixed wireless access outdoor journey. (BR-075).

nodes.label: Require WFM Task Closure with Feedback
nodes.desc: The field workforce management task closure, including captured customer feedback, is required before the order proceeds. (BR-076).

nodes.label: Update Order Status to Workforce
nodes.desc: System updates the order status to the field workforce management system so the technician may proceed with order activation. (BR-100).

nodes.label: Trigger Network Activation (Fibre)
nodes.desc: System triggers network activation through the order management system on completion of the field workforce management task. (BR-100).

nodes.label: Activate Network (FWA Indoor)
nodes.desc: System proceeds to network activation on the planned activation date without waiting for a field workforce management task, for a fixed wireless access indoor journey. (BR-101).

nodes.label: Activate SIM with Network (FWA)
nodes.desc: System activates the SIM together with network activation for a fixed wireless access journey (BR-102).

nodes.label: Pass Fulfilment Data to Billing
nodes.desc: System passes the account, product, service and resource information to the billing system after the field workforce task. (BR-110).

nodes.label: Bill Additional Devices
nodes.desc: System sends the additional devices captured during the field workforce installation task towards the billing system. (BR-110).

nodes.label: Bill FWA Indoor Devices at Order Capture
nodes.desc: System passes the CPE information captured during order capture towards the billing system for a fixed wireless access indoor journey. (BR-111).

nodes.label: Capture Installation Address
nodes.desc: Retail Agent captures the installation address from the utility identifier or by searching. (BR-020).

nodes.label: Cascading Address Selection
nodes.desc: System filters the address selection hierarchically so the street list is constrained by the selected zone and the building list by the selected street. (BR-021).

nodes.label: Scan & Select SIM (FWA)
nodes.desc: Retail Agent scans the SIM serial number and adds it to the cart, only for a fixed wireless access journey. (BR-062).

nodes.label: Scan & Select CPE (FWA)
nodes.desc: Retail Agent scans the customer premises equipment serial number and adds it to the cart, only for a fixed wireless access journey. (BR-062).

nodes.label: Retrieve Appointment Slots
nodes.desc: System fetches the available appointment slots from the field workforce management system together with the lead time. (BR-070).

nodes.label: Select Appointment Slot
nodes.desc: Retail Agent selects an available appointment slot; the customer may request a specific date and time. (BR-070).

nodes.label: Capture Appointment Notes & Flags
nodes.desc: Retail Agent captures additional notes and marks whether the CAF and supporting documents are ready for the appointment. (BR-071).

nodes.label: Pass Appointment Info to Workforce
nodes.desc: System passes the selected date, time slot, notes and collection flags to the field workforce management system. (BR-071).

nodes.label: Skip Appointment for FWA Indoor
nodes.desc: Appointment booking may be skipped for a fixed wireless access indoor journey. (BR-072).

nodes.label: Require Appointment for FWA Outdoor / Fibre
nodes.desc: Appointment booking is required for a fixed wireless access outdoor journey (and fibre). (BR-072).

nodes.label: Deplete FLN Inventory
nodes.desc: System depletes the fixed line number inventory in UIM on payment completion. (BR-092).

nodes.label: Deplete SIM & CPE Inventory
nodes.desc: System depletes the SIM and CPE inventory at the point-of-sale payment system on payment completion. (BR-092).

nodes.label: Receive Order Completion
nodes.desc: System receives the order completion notification from the order management system into the CRM. (BR-112).

nodes.label: Resolve Tracking Record
nodes.desc: System sets the tracking record to resolved once the order is completed and records the order number. (BR-113).

nodes.label: Mark Portability Identifier
nodes.desc: The portability identifier must be marked by the Retail Agent during appointment booking for a port-in journey. (BR-161).

nodes.label: Set Portability Appointment Date
nodes.desc: System sets the portability appointment date in case the portability identifier is marked by the Retail Agent. (BR-161A).

nodes.label: Validate Portability Form & Identity Document
nodes.desc: Retail Agent validates the portability form and identity document received from the number portability system. (BR-172).

nodes.label: Check Mandatory Form Fields & Date
nodes.desc: System validates the portability form date within the allowed period and confirms customer name, identity document number and service details. (BR-173).

agents.Name: Retail Agent
agents.Relationship: Initiates and progresses fibre/FWA activation, migration, home move, port-in journeys
agents.Purpose / Feature: Journey, identity, cart, appointment, contract, payment and order submission across capabilities CAP-01 to CAP-13

agents.Name: Retention Agent
agents.Relationship: Handles retention step of termination requests

agents.Name: Support Agent
agents.Relationship: Handles telephone-originated home move and port-out administration
agents.Purpose / Feature: BR-150 home move request creation via telephone

agents.Name: Field Technician
agents.Relationship: Executes installation, recovery and uninstallation tasks
agents.Purpose / Feature: BR-073 to BR-077 WFM task capture and closure

agents.Name: Sales Agent / Sales Team
agents.Relationship: Searches RFS portal and creates leads
agents.Purpose / Feature: BR-196 to BR-198 RFS portal search, recommendation, lead creation

start.title: Queue Ticket Transaction
start.does: Starts a single fibre/FWA process (activation, migration, home move or portability) from one queue ticket transaction.
start.makes: A new journey/tracking record owned by the initiating agent.
start.example: BR-001: one process per queue ticket transaction; BR-002: tracking record created at journey initiation.

jsm_journey.title: Journey & Session Management
jsm_journey.does: Initiates the journey/session; a tracking record is created and owned by the initiating agent.
jsm_journey.example: FAR_001_JSM_01: process follows the same JSM capability as detailed in the Mobile Post Paid Journey.

kyc_verify.title: Customer Identification & Verification
kyc_verify.does: Runs identity capture/verification per the same KYC capability used in the Mobile Post Paid Journey.
kyc_verify.needs: Qatar identity document (only accepted document type per BR-004).
kyc_verify.makes: Verified identity attributes locked from edit (BR-010).
kyc_verify.example: FAR_001_KYC_01: process follows the same capability ("KYC") as MPAR_001_KYC_*.

cam_account.title: Customer & Account Management
cam_account.does: Creates/matches the customer and account record.
cam_account.example: FAR_001_CAM_01: process follows the same capability ("CAM") as MPAR_001_CAM_*.

rfs_addr_lock.title: Address Locked After Check
rfs_addr_lock.does: Locks the installation address as read-only after the RFS check.
rfs_addr_lock.example: BR-026: the installation address is read only after the ready for service check and can only be changed by recapture.

rfs_poa_upload.title: Proof of Address Upload
rfs_poa_upload.does: Uploads a tenancy document as proof of address.
rfs_poa_upload.example: BR-022 / P-01 / P-03: max 2MB, PDF or Word format; non-conforming files are rejected.

ecc_check.title: Eligibility & Credit Control
ecc_check.does: Validates connection-type eligibility and runs the credit check.
ecc_check.needs: Verified customer identity, postpaid connection type.
ecc_check.makes: Eligibility decision with a distinct failure message per condition.
ecc_check.example: FAR_001_ECC_03: each eligibility failure condition displays its own configured message.

ecc_fail.title: Eligibility Failure Message
ecc_fail.does: Shows a distinct message for the specific eligibility failure.
ecc_fail.makes: Displayed failure reason; journey does not proceed.
ecc_fail.example: Each eligibility failure condition displays its own message from the configured message catalogue.

bam_billing.title: Billing Account Management
bam_billing.does: Creates or selects the billing account and captures the billing profile.
bam_billing.example: FAR_001_BAM_01: process follows the same capability ("BAM") as MPAR_001_BAM_*.

wfm_fail.title: Workforce Failure Handling
wfm_fail.does: Creates a fault ticket for a reported installation issue and allows rescheduling.
wfm_fail.example: BR-077: a reported installation issue creates a fault ticket, updates the task on closure and allows the appointment to be rescheduled.

cvc_checkout.title: Cart Validation & Check Out
cvc_checkout.does: Runs pre-payment validation and displays the payment request summary.
cvc_checkout.makes: Validated, checked-out cart ready for contract.
cvc_checkout.example: FAR_001_CVC_01: process follows the same capability ("CVC") as MPAR_001_CVC_*.

pay_payment.title: Payment & Inventory
pay_payment.does: Processes the upfront payment and issues the receipt.
pay_payment.example: FAR_001_PAY_01: process follows the same capability ("PAY") as MPAR_001_PAY_*.

ord_submit.title: Order Submission
ord_submit.does: Submits the order once all sections are complete and payment is paid.
ord_submit.example: BR-093: the submit action is enabled only when all sections are complete and payment status is paid.

not_order.title: Order Notification
not_order.example: FAR_001_NOT_01: for WFM activities feedback & survey will be done separately at the WFM system.

ins_detect.title: Instant Activation Eligibility Detection
ins_detect.does: Checks RFS response for a reusable pre-installed device eligible for instant activation.
ins_detect.example: BR-130 (Open): the RFS response indicates device presence and instant activation eligibility for an eligible location.

ins_verify.title: Device Serial Verification
ins_verify.does: Confirms the physical device serial matches the RFS-detected device.
ins_verify.example: BR-131 (Open): instant activation does not proceed until the agent confirms the serial number match.

ins_fail.title: Instant Activation Failure Handling
ins_fail.does: Raises a support request and arranges a technician visit on instant-activation failure.
ins_fail.example: BR-135 (Open): a non working service following instant activation raises a support request and arranges a technician visit.

ins_channel.title: Channel Constraint
ins_channel.does: Restricts instant activation to tablet-equipped field agents.
ins_channel.example: BR-136: instant activation is offered on a tablet field agent device and is not offered on a desktop only agent.

mig_eligibility.title: Migration Eligibility Validation
mig_eligibility.does: Validates the source FWA service is eligible for migration to Fibre.
mig_eligibility.needs: Active FWA Indoor/Outdoor service, no conflicting open orders.
mig_eligibility.example: BR-140A: migration is permitted only from active FWA Indoor or FWA Outdoor services to Fibre.

mig_outdoor_recovery.title: Outdoor Device Recovery Appointment
mig_outdoor_recovery.does: Books a device-recovery appointment for FWA Outdoor -> Fibre migrations.
mig_outdoor_recovery.makes: Recovery task prior to migration completion.
mig_outdoor_recovery.example: BR-144: FWA Outdoor migrations require separate outdoor device recovery.

mig_failure.title: Migration Failure Handling
mig_failure.does: Retains the existing FWA service and raises a support ticket on Fibre installation/activation failure.
mig_failure.example: BR-145F: failed Fibre migration shall not automatically terminate the existing FWA service.

hmv_device_decision.title: Old Location Device Handling
hmv_device_decision.does: Decides whether the old-location device is retained or uninstalled.
hmv_device_decision.needs: Origin service type of the move.
hmv_device_decision.makes: Retention (fibre-to-fibre) or uninstallation appointment (FWA outdoor origin).
hmv_device_decision.example: BR-153: no uninstallation appointment for a fibre-to-fibre home move; BR-154: uninstallation appointment captured for FWA outdoor origin.

fpi_confirm.title: Portability Request Confirmation
fpi_confirm.does: Receives the donor service provider's approve/reject decision from NPAS.
fpi_confirm.example: BR-164: NPAS updates the portability request status back after it is approved or rejected by the donor service provider.

fpi_activation.title: Portability Activation After Completion
fpi_activation.does: Activates the ported number after completion, configured during the WFM task.
fpi_activation.example: BR-165: the ported number is activated after portability completion and configured during the field workforce management task, providing no temporary number.

fpo_breach.title: Automatic Processing on Breach
fpo_breach.does: Auto-processes the port-out request when the service level is breached.
fpo_breach.needs: SLA timer expiry with no agent action.
fpo_breach.example: BR-176 (Open): the auto accept against auto reject logic is to be confirmed.

fpo_status_comm.title: Status Communication to NPAS
fpo_status_comm.does: Reports the accept/reject/conditional-accept decision back to NPAS.
fpo_status_comm.example: BR-177 (Open): the full rejection code list is to be supplied by VFQ.

ter_retention.title: Retention Handling
ter_retention.does: Routes the request through the retention process and captures its outcome.
ter_retention.makes: Retention outcome: retained, proceed to terminate, or customer unreachable.
ter_retention.example: BR-202: retention outcome is captured as retained, proceed to terminate or customer unreachable before the next step.

ter_penalty.title: Penalty Charge Display
ter_penalty.does: Calculates and displays the early-termination or lock-in penalty.
ter_penalty.example: BR-204: plan lock-in is 3 months as mentioned in the CAF.

tr_new.title: Tracking Record Created
tr_new.does: Tracking record created automatically at journey initiation (Status_Model: Tracking Record New -> In Progress).
tr_new.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
tr_new.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).

ord_fulfil.title: Order Submission & Fulfilment Routing
ord_fulfil.does: Follows same ORD capability as Mobile Post Paid Journey.
ord_fulfil.needs: An Order Management System order or activation request.
ord_fulfil.makes: An order status update or network activation/deactivation event.

net_activated.title: Order Status to Workforce / CRM
net_activated.does: Order status updated to WFM so technician may proceed; CRM receives activation status (BR-100).
net_activated.needs: An Order Management System order or activation request.
net_activated.makes: An order status update or network activation/deactivation event.

ins_select.title: Instant or Normal Selection
ins_select.does: Agent selects explicitly between instant and normal activation, defaulting to normal where not selected (BR-132, Open).
ins_select.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
ins_select.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
ins_select.example: FAR_002_INS_03: The agent selects instant or normal explicitly and the journey falls back to normal where instant is not chosen.

ins_skip_appt.title: Appointment Auto-Skip
ins_skip_appt.does: Appointment booking auto-skipped for instant activation; agent retains flexibility to book on customer request (BR-133).
ins_skip_appt.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
ins_skip_appt.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
ins_skip_appt.example: FAR_002_INS_04: Appointment booking is skipped by default for instant activation and can still be booked on request.

ins_trigger.title: Immediate Activation Trigger
ins_trigger.does: Immediate network activation flow triggered on order submission; agent notified of activation outcome (BR-134, Open).
ins_trigger.needs: An Order Management System order or activation request.
ins_trigger.makes: An order status update or network activation/deactivation event.
ins_trigger.example: FAR_002_INS_05: Order submission triggers immediate activation and the outcome is notified to the agent.

mig_start.title: Migration Request
mig_start.does: Migration request raised by the customer, captured and confirmed; customer notified (BR-140, Open — request details format TBC by VFQ).
mig_start.needs: A queue ticket, request or system trigger event.
mig_start.makes: A new request/ticket that starts the process.

mig_blocked.title: Migration Blocked
mig_blocked.does: Ineligible services are blocked and the reason is displayed (FIB_MIG_RTL_003_01).
mig_blocked.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
mig_blocked.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.

mig_verify.title: Customer Verification
mig_verify.does: Customer identity verification required before migration initiation; migration cannot proceed without success (BR-141).
mig_verify.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
mig_verify.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
mig_verify.example: FIB_MIG_RTL_003_02: Migration cannot proceed without successful verification.

mig_rfs_check.title: Fibre Service Availability Validation
mig_rfs_check.does: Fibre availability at target installation address validated before migration order creation; proceeds only where Fibre RFS status is available (BR-140B).
mig_rfs_check.needs: RFS Portal / GIS data for the installation address or building.
mig_rfs_check.makes: Updated RFS/GIS serviceability data or address result.
mig_rfs_check.example: FIB_MIG_RTL_003_03: Fibre migration proceeds only where Fibre RFS status is available.

mig_retrieve.title: Existing Service Retrieval
mig_retrieve.does: Retrieves existing service, equipment, MSISDN, SIM and billing information from the active FWA subscription; displayed to agent before confirmation (BR-142).
mig_retrieve.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
mig_retrieve.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
mig_retrieve.example: FIB_MIG_RTL_003_04: All active resources are displayed to the agent before confirmation.

mig_order_capture.title: Migration Order Capture
mig_order_capture.does: Captures migration order, customer contact preference, language, alternate number (BR-142).
mig_order_capture.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
mig_order_capture.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
mig_order_capture.example: FIB_MIG_RTL_003_05: Mandatory migration attributes are stored.

mig_appointment.title: Installation Appointment Creation
mig_appointment.does: Creates a Fibre installation appointment through WFM; appointment mandatory for all migrations (BR-143).
mig_appointment.needs: A Field Workforce Management appointment or task record.
mig_appointment.makes: A created, updated or closed WFM appointment/task.
mig_appointment.example: FIB_MIG_RTL_003_06: Appointment details are successfully booked and stored.

mig_telesales.title: Telesales CAF/Tenancy Flag
mig_telesales.does: Automatically flags CAF and tenancy document collection for telephone-originated migration requests; collection flags passed to WFM (BR-143).
mig_telesales.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
mig_telesales.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
mig_telesales.example: FIB_MIG_RTL_003_07: Collection flags are passed to WFM.

mig_continuity.title: Existing Service Continuity
mig_continuity.does: Existing FWA service kept active until Fibre installation successfully completed; no interruption before successful activation (BR-145A).
mig_continuity.needs: An Order Management System order or activation request.
mig_continuity.makes: An order status update or network activation/deactivation event.
mig_continuity.example: FIB_MIG_RTL_003_09: No service interruption occurs before successful Fibre activation.

mig_fibre_trigger.title: Fibre Activation Trigger
mig_fibre_trigger.does: Fibre activation triggered only after successful installation closure from WFM (BR-145B).
mig_fibre_trigger.needs: An Order Management System order or activation request.
mig_fibre_trigger.makes: An order status update or network activation/deactivation event.
mig_fibre_trigger.example: FIB_MIG_RTL_003_10: Activation request is generated after WFM completion.

mig_sim_deactivate.title: SIM Deactivation
mig_sim_deactivate.does: FWA SIM deactivated only after successful Fibre activation; SIM remains active until Fibre activation succeeds (BR-145).
mig_sim_deactivate.needs: An Order Management System order or activation request.
mig_sim_deactivate.makes: An order status update or network activation/deactivation event.
mig_sim_deactivate.example: FIB_MIG_RTL_003_11: SIM remains active until Fibre activation succeeds.

mig_resource_release.title: Resource Release
mig_resource_release.does: Releases FWA-specific resources, SIM inventory and associated network resources following successful migration (BR-145C).
mig_resource_release.needs: An Order Management System order or activation request.
mig_resource_release.makes: An order status update or network activation/deactivation event.
mig_resource_release.example: FIB_MIG_RTL_003_12: Resources are released and inventory updated.

mig_billing.title: Billing Migration
mig_billing.does: Terminates FWA recurring charges and activates Fibre recurring charges on migration completion date; billing reflects the migrated service only (BR-145D).
mig_billing.needs: Billing System account, payment or credit data.
mig_billing.makes: An updated billing account, charge or payment status.
mig_billing.example: FIB_MIG_RTL_003_13: Billing reflects the migrated service only.

mig_notify.title: Customer Notification
mig_notify.does: Notifies customer at migration request creation, appointment booking, activation success and failure events (BR-145E).
mig_notify.needs: A trigger event needing customer notification.
mig_notify.example: FIB_MIG_RTL_003_14: Notifications are generated at configured milestones.

mig_end.title: Migration Completed
mig_end.does: Migration journey complete: Fibre active, FWA service terminated, billing migrated, customer notified.
mig_end.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
mig_end.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).

hmv_start.title: Home Move Request
hmv_start.does: Created through the retail store queue, or via a support agent (customer calls) assigning to the fibre fulfilment team queue (BR-150).
hmv_start.needs: A queue ticket, request or system trigger event.
hmv_start.makes: A new request/ticket that starts the process.
hmv_start.example: FIB_HMV_RTL_004_01: A home move request is created through the store queue or by a support agent and routed to the fulfilment queue.

hmv_new_addr.title: New Installation Address Capture
hmv_new_addr.does: Captures new installation address for the home move and checks service availability for the new location (BR-151).
hmv_new_addr.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
hmv_new_addr.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
hmv_new_addr.example: FIB_HMV_RTL_004_02: The new location address is captured and its service availability is checked.

hmv_appointment.title: New Location Installation Appointment
hmv_appointment.does: Follows same WFM capability as Fiber Activation Journey (FAR_001_WFM_01 to WFM_06).
hmv_appointment.needs: A Field Workforce Management appointment or task record.
hmv_appointment.makes: A created, updated or closed WFM appointment/task.
hmv_appointment.example: FIB_HMV_RTL_004_03: As in FAR_001_WFM_01 to FAR_001_WFM_06

hmv_number_retain.title: Fixed Line Number Retention
hmv_number_retain.does: New fixed line number selection is not permitted for a home move order; a new fixed line number must be refused (BR-152).
hmv_number_retain.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
hmv_number_retain.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
hmv_number_retain.example: FIB_HMV_RTL_004_11: A new fixed line number must be refused

hmv_uninstall.title: Outdoor Device Uninstallation Appointment
hmv_uninstall.does: Uninstallation appointment for the FWA outdoor device at the old location captured for a move originating from FWA outdoor (BR-154).
hmv_uninstall.needs: A Field Workforce Management appointment or task record.
hmv_uninstall.makes: A created, updated or closed WFM appointment/task.
hmv_uninstall.example: FIB_HMV_RTL_004_05: An uninstallation appointment for the outdoor device at the old location is captured for a move from fixed wireless access outdoor.

hmv_termination.title: Old Location Service Termination
hmv_termination.does: Terminates all services at the old location on the confirmed move date (BR-155).
hmv_termination.needs: An Order Management System order or activation request.
hmv_termination.makes: An order status update or network activation/deactivation event.
hmv_termination.example: FIB_HMV_RTL_004_06: All old location services are terminated on the confirmed move date.

hmv_inventory_release.title: Old Location Inventory Release
hmv_inventory_release.does: Releases CPE and IP address at old location on confirmed move date (BR-156).
hmv_inventory_release.needs: An Order Management System order or activation request.
hmv_inventory_release.makes: An order status update or network activation/deactivation event.
hmv_inventory_release.example: FIB_HMV_RTL_004_07: The old location inventory is released on the confirmed move date in accordance with the local area code rule.

hmv_wfm_new.title: WFM Task Execution at New Location
hmv_wfm_new.does: Follows same WFM capability as Fiber Activation Journey (FAR_001_WFM_07 to WFM_10).
hmv_wfm_new.needs: A Field Workforce Management appointment or task record.
hmv_wfm_new.makes: A created, updated or closed WFM appointment/task.
hmv_wfm_new.example: FIB_HMV_RTL_004_08: As in FAR_001_WFM_07 to FAR_001_WFM_10

hmv_billing.title: Move Date Billing Update
hmv_billing.does: Billing updated on move date with new plan/resources at new location and for terminated services at old location (BR-157).
hmv_billing.needs: Billing System account, payment or credit data.
hmv_billing.makes: An updated billing account, charge or payment status.
hmv_billing.example: FIB_HMV_RTL_004_09: Billing is updated on the move date for both the new location activation and the old location termination.

hmv_equipment_carry.title: FWA Equipment Carried by Customer
hmv_equipment_carry.does: Records that FWA CPE is carried by the customer to the new location where the move is to a FWA service area (BR-158).
hmv_equipment_carry.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
hmv_equipment_carry.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
hmv_equipment_carry.example: FIB_HMV_RTL_004_10: The equipment carried by the customer is recorded on the home move order for a move to a fixed wireless access area.

hmv_end.title: Home Move Completed
hmv_end.does: Home move journey complete: new location active, old location terminated and billed.
hmv_end.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
hmv_end.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).

fpi_start.title: Port In Request
fpi_start.does: Fixed line number being ported in is captured; new number selection not permitted for a port-in journey (BR-160).
fpi_start.needs: A queue ticket, request or system trigger event.
fpi_start.makes: A new request/ticket that starts the process.

fpi_capture.title: Ported Number Capture
fpi_capture.does: Captures the fixed line number being ported in (BR-160).
fpi_capture.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
fpi_capture.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
fpi_capture.example: FIB_FPI_RTL_005_01: The ported fixed line number is captured and new number selection is refused for a port in.

fpi_form.title: Portability Form Submission
fpi_form.does: Agent completes and submits the portability form; customer signs; signed form uploaded before port-in proceeds (BR-162).
fpi_form.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
fpi_form.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
fpi_form.example: FIB_FPI_RTL_005_04: The portability form is completed, signed and uploaded before the port in proceeds.

fpi_request.title: Portability Request Creation
fpi_request.does: Creates the portability request based on the portability identifier; submits to the Number Portability Administration System (BR-163).
fpi_request.needs: A Number Portability Administration System request or response.
fpi_request.makes: A portability request/response exchanged with NPAS.
fpi_request.example: FIB_FPI_RTL_005_05: The portability request must be submitted to the number portability administration system.

fpi_rejected.title: Port In Rejected
fpi_rejected.does: Portability request rejected by donor service provider.
fpi_rejected.needs: A Number Portability Administration System request or response.
fpi_rejected.makes: A portability request/response exchanged with NPAS.

fpi_wfm_exec.title: Portability WFM Appointment Execution
fpi_wfm_exec.does: Triggers WFM task for FLN change based on confirmed port-in date received on or before the captured portability appointment date; date rescheduled based on confirmed port-in date (BR-164A, Open).
fpi_wfm_exec.needs: A Field Workforce Management appointment or task record.
fpi_wfm_exec.makes: A created, updated or closed WFM appointment/task.
fpi_wfm_exec.example: FIB_FPI_RTL_005_07: The system shall trigger the Portability Appointment based on Confirmed Port In Date received on or before Captured Portability Appointment Date

fpi_end.title: Port In Completed
fpi_end.does: Port-in journey complete: number activated on VFQ network.
fpi_end.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
fpi_end.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).

fpo_start.title: Port Out Request Received
fpo_start.does: Trouble ticket automatically created in CRM on receipt of a port-out request from NPAS, carrying ticket and order identifiers (BR-170).
fpo_start.needs: A Number Portability Administration System request or response.
fpo_start.makes: A portability request/response exchanged with NPAS.
fpo_start.example: FIB_FPO_RTL_006_01: A port out request from the administration system creates a trouble ticket carrying the ticket and order identifiers.

fpo_ticket.title: Port Out Trouble Ticket Created
fpo_ticket.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
fpo_ticket.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).

fpo_queue.title: Queue Assignment & Initial SLA Timer
fpo_queue.does: Auto-assigned to the portability queue; initial validation service level timer started (BR-171, Open, P-11: 2 hours).
fpo_queue.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
fpo_queue.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
fpo_queue.example: FIB_FPO_RTL_006_02: A port out ticket is auto assigned to the portability queue and the initial validation timer is started.

fpo_outstanding.title: Outstanding Bill Handling
fpo_outstanding.does: Pending bill moves request to Conditionally Accepted with a defined settlement window (BR-174, P-13: 24 hours).
fpo_outstanding.needs: Billing System account, payment or credit data.
fpo_outstanding.makes: An updated billing account, charge or payment status.
fpo_outstanding.example: FIB_FPO_RTL_006_05: A pending bill moves the request to conditionally accepted with a defined settlement window.

fpo_sla_extend.title: Service Level Extension
fpo_sla_extend.does: Service level timer extended from initial period to final action period where documents are valid (BR-175, P-12: 24 hours).
fpo_sla_extend.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
fpo_sla_extend.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
fpo_sla_extend.example: FIB_FPO_RTL_006_06: A valid document set extends the service level timer to the final action period.

fpo_termination_order.title: Termination Order Generation
fpo_termination_order.does: Termination order generated from the closed ticket, linked to it, wish date set to the confirmed portability date and non-editable (BR-178).
fpo_termination_order.needs: An Order Management System order or activation request.
fpo_termination_order.makes: An order status update or network activation/deactivation event.
fpo_termination_order.example: FIB_FPO_RTL_006_09: A termination order is generated from the closed ticket with a non editable wish date equal to the confirmed portability date.

fpo_deactivation.title: Network Deactivation
fpo_deactivation.does: Services deactivated on confirmed portability date with a one-hour activation window towards the new provider (BR-179, P-15: 1 hour).
fpo_deactivation.needs: An Order Management System order or activation request.
fpo_deactivation.makes: An order status update or network activation/deactivation event.
fpo_deactivation.example: FIB_FPO_RTL_006_10: Services are deactivated on the confirmed date with a one hour activation window towards the new provider.

fpo_quarantine.title: Inventory Quarantine
fpo_quarantine.does: Ported inventory marked to quarantine for the configured period (P-16: 90 days); SIM deactivated and released for FWA service (BR-180).
fpo_quarantine.needs: An Order Management System order or activation request.
fpo_quarantine.makes: An order status update or network activation/deactivation event.
fpo_quarantine.example: FIB_FPO_RTL_006_11: The ported inventory is quarantined for the configured period and the subscriber identity module is deactivated and released.

fpo_end.title: Port Out Completed
fpo_end.does: Port-out journey complete: service deactivated, inventory quarantined.
fpo_end.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
fpo_end.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).

ter_start.title: Termination Request Initiation
ter_start.does: Retail Agent or Retention Agent initiates a termination request from Customer 360 for an active Fibre or FWA service (BR-200).
ter_start.needs: A queue ticket, request or system trigger event.
ter_start.makes: A new request/ticket that starts the process.
ter_start.example: FIB_TER_RTL_007_01: A termination request is created from Customer 360 only for an eligible active Fibre/FWA service.

ter_eligibility.title: Customer & Service Eligibility Validation
ter_eligibility.does: Validates customer identity, service status, open orders, active disputes, fraud/legal blocks and pending termination requests; distinct reason displayed per failure (BR-201).
ter_eligibility.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
ter_eligibility.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
ter_eligibility.example: FIB_TER_RTL_007_02: Termination proceeds only when mandatory validations pass, and a distinct reason is displayed for each failure.

ter_retained.title: Customer Retained
ter_retained.does: Customer accepts retention outcome and does not proceed with termination.
ter_retained.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
ter_retained.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.

ter_outstanding.title: Outstanding Dues Validation
ter_outstanding.does: Retrieves outstanding balance; prevents or conditionally allows termination based on configured VFQ settlement rule (BR-203).
ter_outstanding.needs: Billing System account, payment or credit data.
ter_outstanding.makes: An updated billing account, charge or payment status.
ter_outstanding.example: FIB_TER_RTL_007_04: Outstanding amount is displayed and the termination follows the configured settlement rule.

ter_recovery.title: Equipment Recovery Appointment
ter_recovery.does: WFM appointment triggered/allowed for equipment recovery where service type and device ownership rule require it, including FWA outdoor device recovery; skipped where not applicable (BR-206, Open).
ter_recovery.needs: A Field Workforce Management appointment or task record.
ter_recovery.makes: A created, updated or closed WFM appointment/task.
ter_recovery.example: FIB_TER_RTL_007_06: WFM appointment is required for configured recovery scenarios and skipped where recovery is not applicable.

ter_order_capture.title: Termination Order Capture
ter_order_capture.does: Captures termination reason and requested termination date before submitting the order, along with appointment and payment details; consent, reason and date mandatory (BR-205, Open).
ter_order_capture.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
ter_order_capture.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
ter_order_capture.example: FIB_TER_RTL_007_07: Penalty Details, Appointment Details, Termination reason and requested termination date are mandatory before submission.

ter_order_submit.title: Termination Order Submission
ter_order_submit.does: Creates and submits termination order to Order Management after all mandatory validations, consent and recovery requirements are satisfied (BR-207, Open).
ter_order_submit.needs: An Order Management System order or activation request.
ter_order_submit.makes: An order status update or network activation/deactivation event.
ter_order_submit.example: FIB_TER_RTL_007_08: Termination order is created with customer, service, reason, wish date and recovery information.

ter_deactivation.title: Network Deactivation
ter_deactivation.does: Deactivates the fixed/FWA service on the confirmed termination date; returns deactivation outcome to CRM (BR-208, Open).
ter_deactivation.needs: An Order Management System order or activation request.
ter_deactivation.makes: An order status update or network activation/deactivation event.
ter_deactivation.example: FIB_TER_RTL_007_09: Service is deactivated on the confirmed date and CRM receives success or failure outcome.

ter_billing_close.title: Billing Closure
ter_billing_close.does: Updates billing after termination including final charges, penalty, refund/credit where applicable and service closure status (BR-209, Open).
ter_billing_close.needs: Billing System account, payment or credit data.
ter_billing_close.makes: An updated billing account, charge or payment status.
ter_billing_close.example: FIB_TER_RTL_007_10: Billing update is posted after termination with final charge and closure information.

ter_inventory_release.title: Inventory Release
ter_inventory_release.does: Releases fixed line number, CPE, ONT, FWA SIM/equipment and IP resources based on service type and configured release/quarantine rules (BR-210, Open).
ter_inventory_release.needs: An Order Management System order or activation request.
ter_inventory_release.makes: An order status update or network activation/deactivation event.
ter_inventory_release.example: FIB_TER_RTL_007_11: Applicable resources are released, recovered or quarantined as per configuration.

ter_notify.title: Customer Notification
ter_notify.does: Notifies customer on termination request creation, order submission, appointment where applicable and completion/failure (BR-211, Open).
ter_notify.needs: A trigger event needing customer notification.
ter_notify.example: FIB_TER_RTL_007_12: Notifications are triggered at configured termination milestones.

ter_quarantine.title: Termination Inventory Quarantine
ter_quarantine.does: Ported inventory marked to quarantine for the configured period; SIM deactivated and released for FWA service (BR-180).
ter_quarantine.needs: An Order Management System order or activation request.
ter_quarantine.makes: An order status update or network activation/deactivation event.
ter_quarantine.example: FIB_TER_RTL_007_13: The inventory is quarantined for the configured period and the subscriber identity module is deactivated and released.

ter_end.title: Termination Completed
ter_end.does: Termination journey complete: service deactivated, billing closed, inventory released/quarantined.
ter_end.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
ter_end.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).

rfs_gtm_start.title: GIS Data Ingestion
rfs_gtm_start.does: Site and building data from the geographic information system ingested into the inventory management system, the master for building and connectivity data (BR-190).
rfs_gtm_start.needs: RFS Portal / GIS data for the installation address or building.
rfs_gtm_start.makes: Updated RFS/GIS serviceability data or address result.

rfs_gtm_file.title: Go-to-Market File Generation
rfs_gtm_file.does: Go-to-market file generated from the inventory management system as a full extract (BR-191).
rfs_gtm_file.needs: RFS Portal / GIS data for the installation address or building.
rfs_gtm_file.makes: Updated RFS/GIS serviceability data or address result.

rfs_pickup.title: Pickup & Transformation
rfs_pickup.does: Go-to-market file picked up through the mediation layer, filtered and transformed into the format required by each downstream system (BR-192, Open).
rfs_pickup.needs: RFS Portal / GIS data for the installation address or building.
rfs_pickup.makes: Updated RFS/GIS serviceability data or address result.
rfs_pickup.example: FIB_RFS_008_01: The file is picked up and transformed into the format required by each downstream system.

rfs_distribute.title: Distribution to Downstream Systems
rfs_distribute.does: Distributed to inventory management system (full extract), RFS portal, CRM (delta) and analytics data warehouse (BR-193, Open).
rfs_distribute.needs: RFS Portal / GIS data for the installation address or building.
rfs_distribute.makes: Updated RFS/GIS serviceability data or address result.
rfs_distribute.example: FIB_RFS_008_02: Each downstream system receives its data in the full or delta form defined for it.

rfs_id_mapping.title: Operator Identifier Generation & Mapping
rfs_id_mapping.does: Operator identifier generated separately and mapped to the utility identifier through field survey, supporting one-to-one and one-to-many relationships (BR-194, Open).
rfs_id_mapping.needs: RFS Portal / GIS data for the installation address or building.
rfs_id_mapping.makes: Updated RFS/GIS serviceability data or address result.
rfs_id_mapping.example: FIB_RFS_008_03: The operator identifier is generated and mapped to the utility identifier supporting both relationship types.

rfs_status_update.title: Ready for Service Status Update
rfs_status_update.does: Marks a building ready for service once ready for provisioning; records applicable service level category (BR-195, Open).
rfs_status_update.needs: RFS Portal / GIS data for the installation address or building.
rfs_status_update.makes: Updated RFS/GIS serviceability data or address result.
rfs_status_update.example: FIB_RFS_008_04: A building ready for provisioning is marked ready for service with its service level category recorded.

rfs_portal_search.title: RFS Portal Search
rfs_portal_search.does: Sales team searches the RFS portal by address, utility identifier or area (BR-196).
rfs_portal_search.needs: RFS Portal / GIS data for the installation address or building.
rfs_portal_search.makes: Updated RFS/GIS serviceability data or address result.
rfs_portal_search.example: FIB_RFS_008_05: Each of the three search modes returns the correct ready for service result.

rfs_recommend.title: Recommendation Integration
rfs_recommend.does: Receives offer recommendations from the big data system into the RFS portal (BR-197, Open).
rfs_recommend.needs: RFS Portal / GIS data for the installation address or building.
rfs_recommend.makes: Updated RFS/GIS serviceability data or address result.
rfs_recommend.example: FIB_RFS_008_06: Offer recommendations are received and displayed in the ready for service portal.

rfs_lead.title: Lead Creation from Portal
rfs_lead.does: Sales agent creates a lead in CRM from the RFS portal using the customer mobile number (BR-198, Open).
rfs_lead.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
rfs_lead.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
rfs_lead.example: FIB_RFS_008_07: A lead is created in the customer relationship management system from the portal using the mobile number.

rfs_continuous_update.title: Continuous RFS Update
rfs_continuous_update.does: RFS data updated through subsequent go-to-market file loads and through manual updates from the business (BR-199).
rfs_continuous_update.needs: RFS Portal / GIS data for the installation address or building.
rfs_continuous_update.makes: Updated RFS/GIS serviceability data or address result.
rfs_continuous_update.example: FIB_RFS_008_08: The ready for service data is updated by both file load and manual business update.

rfs_end.title: RFS Data Ready
rfs_end.does: RFS data management cycle complete; portal reflects current serviceability for downstream sales and activation journeys.
rfs_end.needs: RFS Portal / GIS data for the installation address or building.
rfs_end.makes: Updated RFS/GIS serviceability data or address result.

qpc_base_plan.title: Present Eligible Base Plans
qpc_base_plan.does: System presents only the fibre base plans eligible for the customer, determined by the service type available at the address.
qpc_base_plan.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
qpc_base_plan.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
qpc_base_plan.example: FAR_001_QPC_01: Only plans matching the available service type and the customer segment appear in the plan list.

qpc_iptv_bundle.title: Bundle IPTV by Default
qpc_iptv_bundle.does: System bundles the IPTV offering by default with the base plan and displays all associated child plans.
qpc_iptv_bundle.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
qpc_iptv_bundle.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
qpc_iptv_bundle.example: FAR_001_QPC_02: The internet protocol television bundle and its child plans appear in the cart by default with the base plan.

qpc_iptv_remove.title: Remove IPTV Offering
qpc_iptv_remove.does: Retail Agent may remove the IPTV offering from the cart at customer request.
qpc_iptv_remove.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
qpc_iptv_remove.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
qpc_iptv_remove.example: FAR_001_QPC_03: The internet protocol television offering can be removed from the cart during activation.

qpc_addon_mapped.title: Add Mapped Add-Ons Only
qpc_addon_mapped.does: Retail Agent may add only an add-on pre-configured and mapped to the base plan; unmapped add-ons are blocked.
qpc_addon_mapped.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
qpc_addon_mapped.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
qpc_addon_mapped.example: FAR_001_QPC_04: An add on not mapped to the base plan cannot be added to the cart.

qpc_discount_mapped.title: Display Mapped Discounts Only
qpc_discount_mapped.does: System displays only a discount mapped to the product; the section is empty where none applies.
qpc_discount_mapped.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
qpc_discount_mapped.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
qpc_discount_mapped.example: FAR_001_QPC_05: A discount not mapped to the product is not selectable and the section is empty where none applies.

qpc_price_recalc.title: Recalculate Cart Price
qpc_price_recalc.does: System recalculates one-time charges, recurring charges and discounts whenever a product is added, amended or removed from the cart.
qpc_price_recalc.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
qpc_price_recalc.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
qpc_price_recalc.example: FAR_001_QPC_06: Cart totals recalculate on every cart change and reconcile to the sum of the constituent charges.

num_fln_select.title: Select Fixed Line Number
num_fln_select.does: Retail Agent searches the free number list and selects a preferred fixed line number into the cart.
num_fln_select.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
num_fln_select.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
num_fln_select.example: FAR_001_NUM_01: A search returns available fixed line numbers of category free number and a selected number is added to the cart.

num_mobile_fwa_select.title: Select Mobile Number for FWA
num_mobile_fwa_select.does: Retail Agent searches the free number list and selects a mobile number into the cart, only for a fixed wireless access journey.
num_mobile_fwa_select.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
num_mobile_fwa_select.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
num_mobile_fwa_select.example: FAR_001_NUM_02: A mobile number can be selected for a fixed wireless access journey and the selection is refused for a fibre journey.

num_star_prohibit_fwa.title: Prohibit Star Number for FWA
num_star_prohibit_fwa.does: A star number may not be selected for a fixed wireless access indoor or outdoor journey.
num_star_prohibit_fwa.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
num_star_prohibit_fwa.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
num_star_prohibit_fwa.example: FAR_001_NUM_03: A star number is not offered or selectable for a fixed wireless access journey.

num_fln_select_alt.title: FLN Selection
num_fln_select_alt.does: Retail Agent searches the FLN from the list of FLN and adds it to the cart; a FLN can be searched and added for a Fiber or Fixed Wireless Access journey (BR-060).
num_fln_select_alt.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
num_fln_select_alt.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
num_fln_select_alt.example: FAR_001_NUM_06: A FLN can be searched and added for a Fiber or Fixed Wireless Access Journey.

num_msisdn_select.title: MSISDN Selection (FWA)
num_msisdn_select.does: Follows the same NUM capability as Mobile Post Paid Journey (MPAR_001_NUM_13). A search returns available free numbers restricted to fixed wireless access journeys and a selected mobile number is added to the cart; a star number is not offered or selectable for a fixed wireless access journey (BR-061).
num_msisdn_select.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
num_msisdn_select.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
num_msisdn_select.example: FAR_001_NUM_05: A search returns available free numbers restricted to fixed wireless access journeys and a selected mobile number is added to the cart; a star number is not offered or selectable for a fixed wireless access journey.

num_review.title: Review Number Before Confirmation
num_review.does: System displays the number category and applicable charges for the agent to review before the number selection is confirmed.
num_review.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
num_review.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
num_review.example: FAR_001_NUM_04: The number category and charges are displayed before confirmation.

caf_offline_upload.title: Upload Offline Signed CAF
caf_offline_upload.does: Retail Agent uploads a manually signed contract application form (PDF/JPG). Follows the same CAF capability as the Mobile Postpaid journey (MPAR_001_CAF_*, FAR_001_CAF_01).
caf_offline_upload.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
caf_offline_upload.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
caf_offline_upload.example: FAR_001_CAF_02: A signed form within the format and size limit is uploaded and a non conforming file is rejected. FAR_001_CAF_01: As in MPAR_001_CAF_*

caf_digital_signature.title: Capture Digital Signature
caf_digital_signature.does: Retail Agent selects the digital CAF option and touch-screen option; system displays the captured signature.
caf_digital_signature.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
caf_digital_signature.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
caf_digital_signature.example: FAR_001_CAF_03: Each signature capture method routes to the corresponding device and the captured signature is embedded in the form.

caf_skip_by_role.title: Skip CAF by Fulfilment Role
caf_skip_by_role.does: The CAF submission step may be skipped by an agent holding the fulfilment role.
caf_skip_by_role.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
caf_skip_by_role.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
caf_skip_by_role.example: FAR_001_CAF_04: A fulfilment role can skip the submission step and other roles cannot.

caf_supporting_docs.title: Upload Supporting Documents
caf_supporting_docs.does: Retail Agent uploads additional and supporting documents into a separate section (PDF/JPG).
caf_supporting_docs.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
caf_supporting_docs.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
caf_supporting_docs.example: FAR_001_CAF_05: Additional documents within the format and size limit are uploaded, sectioned and viewable.

caf_activity_comments.title: Capture Activity Comments
caf_activity_comments.does: Retail Agent captures activity comments to be passed to the field workforce management task.
caf_activity_comments.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
caf_activity_comments.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
caf_activity_comments.example: FAR_001_CAF_06: Activity comments captured by the agent are passed to the field workforce management task.

rfs_availability_search.title: Search Point of Presence
rfs_availability_search.does: Retail Agent searches the point of presence in the ready-for-service screen by address or utility identifier.
rfs_availability_search.needs: RFS Portal / GIS data for the installation address or building.
rfs_availability_search.makes: Updated RFS/GIS serviceability data or address result.
rfs_availability_search.example: FAR_001_RFS_03: A search by each of the three keys returns the ready for service result for the location.

rfs_addr_autofill.title: Auto-fill Address from RFS
rfs_addr_autofill.does: System auto-fills the address from the ready-for-service data based on the utility identifier.
rfs_addr_autofill.needs: RFS Portal / GIS data for the installation address or building.
rfs_addr_autofill.makes: Updated RFS/GIS serviceability data or address result.
rfs_addr_autofill.example: FAR_001_RFS_04: The building number, street number, zone and unit are populated from the ready for service response.

rfs_service_type_display.title: Display Available Service Types
rfs_service_type_display.does: System displays the service types available at the searched location: Fibre, FWA indoor, FWA outdoor.
rfs_service_type_display.needs: RFS Portal / GIS data for the installation address or building.
rfs_service_type_display.makes: Updated RFS/GIS serviceability data or address result.
rfs_service_type_display.example: FAR_001_RFS_05: The service types available at the location are displayed to the agent.

rfs_cpe_detect.title: Detect CPE / ONT Information
rfs_cpe_detect.does: System displays the CPE and ONT information retrieved from the ready-for-service response, where available.
rfs_cpe_detect.needs: RFS Portal / GIS data for the installation address or building.
rfs_cpe_detect.makes: Updated RFS/GIS serviceability data or address result.
rfs_cpe_detect.example: FAR_001_RFS_06: Detected device information is displayed where the ready for service response indicates a device is present.

wfm_task_capture.title: Capture WFM Task Execution
wfm_task_capture.does: System captures from the field workforce management task the ONT serial number, set-top box and related fulfilment data.
wfm_task_capture.needs: A Field Workforce Management appointment or task record.
wfm_task_capture.makes: A created, updated or closed WFM appointment/task.
wfm_task_capture.example: FAR_001_WFM_07: The four device and resource values captured by the technician are returned to and stored in the system.
