wfm_mesh_device_rule.title: Apply Complimentary Mesh Device Rule
wfm_mesh_device_rule.does: System applies the configured complimentary allowance of two mesh devices before charging further mesh devices.
wfm_mesh_device_rule.needs: A Field Workforce Management appointment or task record.
wfm_mesh_device_rule.makes: A created, updated or closed WFM appointment/task.
wfm_mesh_device_rule.example: FAR_001_WFM_08: The first two mesh devices carry no charge and further devices carry the configured monthly recurring charge.

wfm_indoor_outdoor_capture.title: Capture Indoor & Outdoor Device Serials
wfm_indoor_outdoor_capture.does: System captures both the indoor and outdoor CPE serial numbers for a fixed wireless access outdoor journey.
wfm_indoor_outdoor_capture.needs: A Field Workforce Management appointment or task record.
wfm_indoor_outdoor_capture.makes: A created, updated or closed WFM appointment/task.
wfm_indoor_outdoor_capture.example: FAR_001_WFM_09: Both the indoor and outdoor device serial numbers are captured for a fixed wireless access outdoor task.

wfm_task_closure.title: Require WFM Task Closure with Feedback
wfm_task_closure.does: The field workforce management task closure, including captured customer feedback, is required before the order proceeds.
wfm_task_closure.needs: A Field Workforce Management appointment or task record.
wfm_task_closure.makes: A created, updated or closed WFM appointment/task.
wfm_task_closure.example: FAR_001_WFM_10: The order does not proceed until the task closure with customer feedback is received.

net_status_update.title: Update Order Status to Workforce
net_status_update.does: System updates the order status to the field workforce management system so the technician may proceed with order activation.
net_status_update.needs: An Order Management System order or activation request.
net_status_update.makes: An order status update or network activation/deactivation event.
net_status_update.example: FAR_001_NET_04: The field workforce management system receives the order status update.

net_activate_fibre.title: Trigger Network Activation (Fibre)
net_activate_fibre.does: System triggers network activation through the order management system on completion of the field workforce management task.
net_activate_fibre.needs: An Order Management System order or activation request.
net_activate_fibre.makes: An order status update or network activation/deactivation event.
net_activate_fibre.example: FAR_001_NET_01: Network activation is triggered on task completion for fibre and the status is updated in the customer relationship management system.

net_activate_fwa_indoor.title: Activate Network (FWA Indoor)
net_activate_fwa_indoor.does: System proceeds to network activation on the planned activation date without waiting for a field workforce management task, for a fixed wireless access indoor journey.
net_activate_fwa_indoor.needs: An Order Management System order or activation request.
net_activate_fwa_indoor.makes: An order status update or network activation/deactivation event.
net_activate_fwa_indoor.example: FAR_001_NET_02: Network activation proceeds on the planned date without a field workforce management task for fixed wireless access indoor.

net_activate_sim.title: Activate SIM with Network (FWA)
net_activate_sim.does: System activates the SIM together with network activation for a fixed wireless access journey (BR-102).
net_activate_sim.needs: An Order Management System order or activation request.
net_activate_sim.makes: An order status update or network activation/deactivation event.
net_activate_sim.example: FAR_001_NET_03: The subscriber identity module is activated with network activation for a fixed wireless access journey.

fin_billing_pass.title: Pass Fulfilment Data to Billing
fin_billing_pass.does: System passes the account, product, service and resource information to the billing system after the field workforce task.
fin_billing_pass.needs: Billing System account, payment or credit data.
fin_billing_pass.makes: An updated billing account, charge or payment status.
fin_billing_pass.example: FAR_001_FIN_01: The billing system receives the account, product, service and resource information with per line prices.

fin_device_billing.title: Bill Additional Devices
fin_device_billing.does: System sends the additional devices captured during the field workforce installation task towards the billing system.
fin_device_billing.needs: Billing System account, payment or credit data.
fin_device_billing.makes: An updated billing account, charge or payment status.
fin_device_billing.example: FAR_001_FIN_02: Additional devices captured during installation are reflected in the billing update.

fin_fwa_indoor_billing.title: Bill FWA Indoor Devices at Order Capture
fin_fwa_indoor_billing.does: System passes the CPE information captured during order capture towards the billing system for a fixed wireless access indoor journey.
fin_fwa_indoor_billing.needs: Billing System account, payment or credit data.
fin_fwa_indoor_billing.makes: An updated billing account, charge or payment status.
fin_fwa_indoor_billing.example: FAR_001_FIN_03: The order capture device information is billed for a fixed wireless access indoor journey.

rfs_addr_capture2.title: Capture Installation Address
rfs_addr_capture2.does: Retail Agent captures the installation address from the utility identifier or by searching.
rfs_addr_capture2.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
rfs_addr_capture2.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
rfs_addr_capture2.example: FAR_001_RFS_01: The installation address can be captured by utility identifier and, separately, by the zone street building search.

rfs_cascading_addr.title: Cascading Address Selection
rfs_cascading_addr.does: System filters the address selection hierarchically so the street list is constrained by the selected zone and the building list by the selected street.
rfs_cascading_addr.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
rfs_cascading_addr.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
rfs_cascading_addr.example: FAR_001_RFS_02: Selecting a zone restricts the street list and selecting a street restricts the building list.

sim_scan_select.title: Scan & Select SIM (FWA)
sim_scan_select.does: Retail Agent scans the SIM serial number and adds it to the cart, only for a fixed wireless access journey.
sim_scan_select.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
sim_scan_select.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
sim_scan_select.example: FAR_001_SIM_01: A subscriber identity module can be scanned and added for a fixed wireless access journey and is refused for fibre.

cpe_scan_select.title: Scan & Select CPE (FWA)
cpe_scan_select.does: Retail Agent scans the customer premises equipment serial number and adds it to the cart, only for a fixed wireless access journey.
cpe_scan_select.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
cpe_scan_select.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
cpe_scan_select.example: FAR_001_PHY_01: Customer premises equipment can be scanned and added for a fixed wireless access journey and is refused for fibre.

wfm_slot_retrieval.title: Retrieve Appointment Slots
wfm_slot_retrieval.does: System fetches the available appointment slots from the field workforce management system together with the lead time.
wfm_slot_retrieval.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
wfm_slot_retrieval.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
wfm_slot_retrieval.example: FAR_001_WFM_01: Available appointment slots with lead time and technician availability are returned from the field workforce management system.

wfm_slot_selection.title: Select Appointment Slot
wfm_slot_selection.does: Retail Agent selects an available appointment slot; the customer may request a specific date and time.
wfm_slot_selection.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
wfm_slot_selection.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
wfm_slot_selection.example: FAR_001_WFM_02: A slot can be selected and a customer requested date and time can be captured.

wfm_notes_capture.title: Capture Appointment Notes & Flags
wfm_notes_capture.does: Retail Agent captures additional notes and marks whether the CAF and supporting documents are ready for the appointment.
wfm_notes_capture.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
wfm_notes_capture.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
wfm_notes_capture.example: FAR_001_WFM_03: Notes and the two collection flags are captured and passed to the field workforce management system.

wfm_info_to_workforce.title: Pass Appointment Info to Workforce
wfm_info_to_workforce.does: System passes the selected date, time slot, notes and collection flags to the field workforce management system.
wfm_info_to_workforce.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
wfm_info_to_workforce.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
wfm_info_to_workforce.example: FAR_001_WFM_04: The selected appointment information is present in the field workforce management task.

wfm_skip_fwa_indoor.title: Skip Appointment for FWA Indoor
wfm_skip_fwa_indoor.does: Appointment booking may be skipped for a fixed wireless access indoor journey.
wfm_skip_fwa_indoor.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
wfm_skip_fwa_indoor.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
wfm_skip_fwa_indoor.example: FAR_001_WFM_05: Appointment booking can be skipped for a fixed wireless access indoor journey.

wfm_mandatory_fwa_outdoor.title: Require Appointment for FWA Outdoor / Fibre
wfm_mandatory_fwa_outdoor.does: Appointment booking is required for a fixed wireless access outdoor journey (and fibre).
wfm_mandatory_fwa_outdoor.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
wfm_mandatory_fwa_outdoor.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
wfm_mandatory_fwa_outdoor.example: FAR_001_WFM_06: A fixed wireless access outdoor journey cannot proceed without an appointment.

pay_fln_deplete.title: Deplete FLN Inventory
pay_fln_deplete.does: System depletes the fixed line number inventory in UIM on payment completion.
pay_fln_deplete.needs: Billing System account, payment or credit data.
pay_fln_deplete.makes: An updated billing account, charge or payment status.
pay_fln_deplete.example: FAR_001_PAY_02: The fixed line number inventory position is updated on payment completion.

pay_sim_cpe_deplete.title: Deplete SIM & CPE Inventory
pay_sim_cpe_deplete.does: System depletes the SIM and CPE inventory at the point-of-sale payment system on payment completion.
pay_sim_cpe_deplete.needs: Billing System account, payment or credit data.
pay_sim_cpe_deplete.makes: An updated billing account, charge or payment status.
pay_sim_cpe_deplete.example: FAR_001_PAY_03: The subscriber identity module and equipment inventory positions are updated on payment completion.

fin_order_completion.title: Receive Order Completion
fin_order_completion.does: System receives the order completion notification from the order management system into the CRM.
fin_order_completion.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
fin_order_completion.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
fin_order_completion.example: FAR_001_FIN_04: A completion event sets the order status to completed in the customer relationship management system.

fin_tracking_update.title: Resolve Tracking Record
fin_tracking_update.does: System sets the tracking record to resolved once the order is completed and records the order number.
fin_tracking_update.needs: Data already captured earlier in the journey (customer, cart or order record).
fin_tracking_update.makes: An updated CRM record (customer, cart, order or tracking record).
fin_tracking_update.example: FAR_001_FIN_05: Order completion sets the tracking record to resolved with the order number recorded.

fpi_identifier_mark.title: Mark Portability Identifier
fpi_identifier_mark.does: The portability identifier must be marked by the Retail Agent during appointment booking for a port-in journey.
fpi_identifier_mark.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
fpi_identifier_mark.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
fpi_identifier_mark.example: FIB_FPI_RTL_005_02: The portability identifier is captured at appointment booking for a port in journey.

fpi_appt_date.title: Set Portability Appointment Date
fpi_appt_date.does: System sets the portability appointment date in case the portability identifier is marked by the Retail Agent.
fpi_appt_date.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
fpi_appt_date.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
fpi_appt_date.example: FIB_FPI_RTL_005_03: The portability Appointment Date is captured at appointment booking for a port in journey.

fpo_doc_validate.title: Validate Portability Form & Identity Document
fpo_doc_validate.does: Retail Agent validates the portability form and identity document received from the number portability system.
fpo_doc_validate.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
fpo_doc_validate.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
fpo_doc_validate.example: FIB_FPO_RTL_006_03: Documents are validated and can be uploaded to the port out ticket.

fpo_mandatory_checks.title: Check Mandatory Form Fields & Date
fpo_mandatory_checks.does: System validates the portability form date within the allowed period and confirms customer name, identity document number and service details.
fpo_mandatory_checks.needs: Retail/Retention/Support agent action in the CRM/order-capture UI.
fpo_mandatory_checks.makes: Data captured or a decision recorded by the agent.
fpo_mandatory_checks.example: FIB_FPO_RTL_006_04: A form outside the validity period or with a mandatory mismatch fails validation.
